```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  tidy = FALSE, 
  size = "small",
  fig.width = 5, fig.height = 3) 

options(scipen = 1, knitr.kable.NA = '')

# load packages
library(maps)
library(ggplot2)
library(viridis)
library(sf)
library(leaflet)
library(ggspatial)
library(readr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(fivethirtyeight)
library(usmap)
```

```{r}
storms <- read_csv("../data/FINAL_wrangled_storm.csv") |> filter(EVENT_TYPE %in% c("Flood", "Tornado", "Debris Flow", "Lightning", "Thunderstorm Wind", "Flash Flood")) |>
  st_as_sf(coords = c("BEGIN_LON", "BEGIN_LAT"), crs = 4326) |>
  arrange(desc(deaths))

us_states1 <- us_map()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = us_states1) + 
  geom_sf(data = storms, aes(size = deaths, color = EVENT_TYPE)) 
```
```{r}
storms <- read_csv("../data/FINAL_wrangled_storm.csv") |> filter(contiguous_us) |> filter(EVENT_TYPE %in% c("Flood", "Tornado", "Debris Flow", "Lightning", "Thunderstorm Wind", "Flash Flood")) |> 
  st_as_sf(coords = c("BEGIN_LON", "BEGIN_LAT"), crs = 4326) |>
  arrange(desc(deaths))

us_states2 <- maps::map("state",
                     plot = FALSE, fill = TRUE) |> st_as_sf()

ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = us_states2) + 
  geom_sf(data = storms, aes(size = deaths, color = EVENT_TYPE)) + theme_void()
```
